docs.summary: Where a prefab's contents come from, which decides whether they can be written back.
An authored .prefab asset. Editable, and instances can apply their overrides to it.

Generated by importing a source file, such as a model. Read-only: its contents are rebuilt on every import, so anything written to it would be discarded, and writing to the file it came from would destroy that file. Instances still track and revert overrides.
